name: Member's Mark Premium Chunk Chicken Breast in Water (6 x 12.5 oz Cans)
whyItWorks: White chicken breast chunks cooked in water and salt. The meat is tender, flaky, and breaks down effortlessly with minimal mastication, supplying clean protein during low-residue recovery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain broth. Mix with a little olive oil or light mayo, or stir directly into warm white rice or chicken noodle broth.
